texts.biography: Poison has never been a good commander. However, his advantage over the enemy is the ability to be in several places at once. Brute force is useless against him - after a blow, he only falls apart in two, and each of them acts separately.
texts.name: Poison

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Horrors and Terrors she commands for each level attainded after 4th level.
specialty.name: Horrors
